answer: Willow-Bound Physical Relay Quota. Each agent identity must anchor to a distinct relay device that signs messages with a hardware key sealed in tamper-evident onyx casing. Registration requires the relay to complete a timed challenge over a dedicated physical port, proving the device exists and is uniquely powered. A single operator must buy, house, power, and maintain one relay per identity, and cloned keys fail the sealed-case check, so mass fabrication carries real hardware, space, and energy cost per sybil, not velvet paperwork.
